tool_input.description: Append the change, progression log and camera alarm lines

result:
The heirs build shipped as v37.30 and is on his PC (the ship printed "ON HIS PC v37.30"). It passed the full gate, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (85/374, 165/593).

**What it adds:**
- **Traits:** there are 17 small traits, 10 good and 7 bad (light step, loud boots, steady hands, shaky, heavy feet, field medic, keen eye, and so on). Each one is a third to a half the size of one gear trait. They feed the same reader as gear: bonuses stop at the same caps, and a bad trait can never take a stat below minus its base. With no traits and nothing worn, a raid plays exactly as before. The demo and the bot test raids ignore traits.
- **Names:** there are 40 rough lower case names. The numeral counts how many pillagers of that name the lineage has had, living and dead, and starts at "ii" ("brakka", then "brakka ii").
- **Heirs:** three heirs are rolled from the account, so a reload shows the same three and the raid seed never moves. The roll is saved until one is chosen. Each heir has a different name and one or two traits, never two on the same stat.
- **Birth:** choosing heir 1 makes it the next generation and clears the roll. A birth with no choice takes the first heir, so the death job's call (v37.29) now hands out an heir with its traits. His current character (generation one) has no traits.
- **Account card:** "your stats" now opens with a card reading "your Nth pillager", the name with its numeral, and up to two traits, good in green and bad in red. The stats page hides and places cards by their position in the list, so the new card sits last in the list and is moved to the front on screen; the other cards keep their places.

**Pictures:** 1080p and 4K look clean, with no layout problems flagged. The critic scored the screen 3, which is the finish line for this screen. I skipped its one point about my card ("delete the card") because his order puts the card there; its other points are about older parts of the screen. The picture shows the card without traits, because the camera's test profile is an unnamed first-generation pillager. The check proves the green and red trait lines, and I asked the coordinator in `alarms.md` for a camera setup that shows them.

**Watch for:** nothing changes in play until a pillager dies. After that, the new pillager carries its traits into raids.

The progression log, the UI change log and my task notes are updated.

TASK DONE
